jamie: Heads up — console telemetry pipeline started ingesting routing/quota headers in the new compact envelope format. After the change rolled this morning some client libs (py/ts) are showing dropped route attribution and console dashboards show 15% of requests as "unattributed". Anyone seeing similar in SDK telemetry?

vikram: saw spikes. errors from ts-client: `InvalidRouteHeaderError` in route-parser. Py client logs show parse warnings only, but downstream console can't map trace -> route.

jamie: logs pasted here (short):
```
ERROR route-parser: invalid header "x-rd-routecompact" payload too short
trace_id=01a2b3c4
```

sarah: this was an intentional change from the console side to reduce header size (we switched to a compact base64 + checksum envelope, header name `x-rd-routecompact`). The intention was backward-compatible but we accidentally changed the canonical key ordering which broke a naive parser. Sorry — my bad.

maria: we can handle this in the SDKs with a normalization/fallback: if `x-rd-route` missing, try legacy `x-rd-route-meta`, then `x-rd-routecompact` and run envelope unwrap. Example pseudo: 
```py
route_hdr = req.headers.get("x-rd-route") or req.headers.get("x-rd-route-meta") or req.headers.get("x-rd-routecompact")
route = parse_route_envelope(route_hdr)
```
This would be a quick patch for python/ts. Go maybe the same.

vikram: agree — minimal change. Also add a small len/checksum guard. Want to avoid accepting malformed envelopes silently.

kevin: ops/console: can we revert console change while SDKs push patches? We have customers on Dedicated who hit attribution-based quotas. Reverting would buy time.

sarah: we can revert canary by rolling back the feature flag in ~15 mins. But we still need SDK patches so future rollout is safe.

maria: proposed rollout plan: 1) patch python SDK (0.12.x) to normalize header + add unit tests (cover old, new, malformed) — cut release in ~2 hours; 2) patch ts SDK similarly and publish canary + diff docs; 3) console rollback now, reintroduce behind opt-in feature flag; 4) monitoring: dashboard widget for "unattributed route rate" and sample traces for first 1k events.

jamie: +1. Also can we add a lightweight migration header `x-rd-route-compat: 1` that console emits during opt-in so SDKs can short-circuit parsing? That'll make rollbacks easier.

sarah: yup we can add that. console will emit compat header when feature-flag ON.

devex-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback scheduled for 1749801450, status: pending.

vikram: I'll start the py patch PR now and ping for review. maria want to own ts?

maria: can do. I'll also add a small integration test that spins up a fake console and verifies attribution mapping.

kevin: I'll coordinate the rollback and confirm quota systems won't charge wrong buckets during the window. Please tag me when PRs are ready.

jamie: thanks everyone. After releases let's meet briefly in #devex in 30m to confirm metrics look good.

maria: cc @kevin @sarah i'll post links to PRs here when ready.

vikram: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-client/pull/237 (draft) — implements fallback + checksum guard.

sarah: console feature-flag toggled off in canary cluster. Monitoring will stream metrics in 5 mins.

jamie: great — keeping this thread for final thumbs up. :thumbsup:
